abi_version.encoding: uint64_t: major in bits 63..32, minor in bits 31..0

targets.non_ios: validating UNSUPPORTED stubs; no Apple framework link

outputs.read_found: uint8_t: 0 absent, 1 present; distinguishes a present empty secret
outputs.read_secret: FrameworkOwnedBuffer initialized empty on entry; caller destroys a returned owned buffer with framework_owned_buffer_destroy
outputs.store_effective_policy_flags: uint32_t policy bits; zero on failure
outputs.remove_removed: uint8_t: 0 absent, 1 removed; zero on failure
outputs.native_os_status: optional int32_t; zero before work and for non-platform errors; exact nonzero native status on platform errors

ios_secure_storage.panic_boundary: Each exported function catches Rust panics and returns FRAMEWORK_STATUS_PANIC; no panic unwinds across C.
ios_secure_storage.threading: Synchronous and potentially blocking; caller chooses the calling thread.

ownership.inputs: FrameworkStr and FrameworkSlice are borrowed through the call and are not retained
ownership.read_secret: FrameworkOwnedBuffer must be released exactly once with framework_owned_buffer_destroy; out_secret must not contain a live owned allocation on entry

view_fields.action_id: present only for CustomAction and TextInput
view_fields.user_text: present only for TextInput; empty text remains present by kind

status_mapping.FRAMEWORK_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT: Malformed spans, invalid UTF-8 or IDs, unknown tags, non-empty unused fields, or null required outputs
status_mapping.FRAMEWORK_STATUS_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: String reserve failure or view span length not representable as u64
status_mapping.FRAMEWORK_STATUS_PANIC: Panic caught by create or get_view

notification_responses.panic_boundary: Create and get_view catch Rust panics and return FRAMEWORK_STATUS_PANIC; destroy has no recoverable panic path; no panic unwinds across C.
notification_responses.call_thread: Synchronous; C selects the call thread

ownership.inputs: FrameworkStr spans are borrowed through create and copied into the owned response; no input span is retained
ownership.handle: Destroy the original handle once through its writable pointer slot; destroy clears that slot before drop; do not copy or destroy an alias
ownership.view: View spans borrow from the handle and expire at destroy

notification_responses.limits: Creates, views, and destroys values only; no delivery, delegate, callback, event queue, polling API, executor, native response object, or B12 lifecycle semantics

ownership.FrameworkSlice: borrowed bytes; source must outlive each foreign use
ownership.FrameworkStr: borrowed UTF-8 bytes; source must outlive each foreign use

FrameworkOwnedBuffer.rule: destroy the original unchanged framework-created descriptor once; NULL is a no-op; copied or modified descriptors are invalid

ownership.FrameworkOperationHandle: opaque fixed-width value; zero means absent
ownership.FrameworkErrorHandle: opaque fixed-width value; zero means no detail

options_v1.future_sized_struct_check: an accepting API must check struct_size and abi_version before reading fields; no options-accepting API is exported by this slice

panic_boundary: No panic may unwind across C ABI. F1 core exports are arithmetic-only/destructor-only and have no recoverable panic path; optional ios_secure_storage and notification_responses exports catch Rust panics and return FRAMEWORK_STATUS_PANIC where they have a status return.
static_library_runtime: framework-abi/std is enabled in this opt-in static library to provide the allocator and panic runtime needed by owned C buffers, notification-response values, and panic containment; framework-abi remains no_std by default for Rust consumers.
